_meta.description: Curated, deterministic inputs that cannot be fetched from a registry API: documented CVE history, disclosure-process facts, and product-level judgments. Each entry is keyed by ecosystem/name. Evidence level 'D' = documented public fact (verify before external release); 'V' = verified as noted.

npm/express.patch_publication: regular security patch line across 4.x and 5.x

npm/lodash-es / npm/lodash.patch_publication: project is feature-frozen but published a security fix in 2020; no active development

npm/dom-to-image.recommendation: replace with an actively maintained alternative (e.g. html-to-image / modern-screenshot)

npm/qrcode.maintenance_status: no releases since 2024; last repo push 2024-08-23

npm/bcrypt.notes: native build; consider bcryptjs attacker-timing tradeoffs; kelektiv org publishes occasional updates

pypi/pillow.cve_history_note: long history of image-parsing CVEs, consistently patched by python-pillow org; keep current within major

pypi/huggingface-hub.cve_history_note: CVE-2024-23651..23653 (HF aspirates: pickle deserialization) fixed in hub code; treat model downloads as untrusted

pypi/gunicorn.notes: Request smuggling vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-1135, CVE-2024-6827 class) around 20.x -> 22.x/23.x; ensure major line is current
pypi/gunicorn.patch_publication: maintainer published fixes when disclosed, cadence irregular

sbd_indicators: developed under libjxl org with Google-affiliated maintainers
cargo/jxl.notes: parses untrusted image bytes; keep on newest minor

cargo/moxcms.notes: single maintainer; very high release frequency; no published security policy

cargo/pic-scale.notes: single maintainer; very high release frequency; downloads concentrated in a downstream (us)

product.intended_use: All SBOM components are used within their documented intended purpose: web frameworks for API/SPA, image libraries for media processing, ONNX stack for inference, Flutter plugins for mobile platform integration. Server-side react/react-email usage is server-side email template rendering (an intended use).
binary_artifacts: ffmpeg (external system binary, not in this SBOM)
product_gaps: immich repository has no SECURITY.md / documented vulnerability disclosure process (CRA Annex I relevant)
no automated dependency-vuln CI scan wired to the SBOM yet
